title: Fake Microsoft security alert (credential harvesting)
subject: FW: Urgent: Your Account Security Alert
body:
Dear Customer,

We detected an unusual sign-in to your account from an unknown location. Your account will be suspended within 24 hours unless you verify your identity immediately.

Sign in now: http://microsoft.com.account-verify.logins-updates.example/signin

Please confirm your password and the verification code we send you.

Microsoft Account Team

title: CEO 'lost wallet' wire-transfer request (BEC)
subject: Quick favour - need this today
body:
Hi,

I lost my wallet at the airport and I'm stuck at the gate. I need you to wire transfer funds for my flight immediately, before the close of business. This is strictly confidential - do not discuss with anyone and bypass the usual approval steps, I'll explain later.

Reply with the account number you will use and I'll send the beneficiary details.

Sent from my iPhone
Michael

title: Internal IT 'password expires' with subdomain trap
subject: Mandatory: Password expires in 24 hrs
body:
Hello,

Your network password expires in 24 hours. To keep access to your email and files, you must update your password today.

Update password: [www.decodelabs.tech](http://www.decodelabs.tech.login-update.example/reset)

Failure to act will result in your account being locked.

IT Security Team

title: Fake Microsoft invoice - callback scam (TOAD), no links
subject: Invoice #MS-48213: Subscription renewed - $190.00
body:
Your Microsoft 365 subscription has been renewed.

Amount charged: $190.00

If you did not authorize this charge, call our billing support immediately at 1-800-555-0142 to cancel and receive a refund. PAYMENT OVERDUE if not disputed within 24 hours.

title: Genuine internal project update (control sample)
subject: Q3 Project Status Update - Non-Urgent
body:
Hi Team,

Please review the attached project status for Q3 at your earliest convenience.

No immediate action is required.

Thanks,
Sarah

title: HR benefits questionnaire with shortened link (borderline)
subject: Action Required: 2026 Healthcare Benefits Questionnaire
body:
Hi all,

Please complete the 2026 healthcare benefits questionnaire by 5 PM Friday. The deadline cannot be extended.

Complete it here: https://bit.ly/2026-benefits

Thanks,
HR Team

title: Fake Google account recovery - QR code (quishing)
subject: Action required: Recover your Google Account
body:
Hello,

We noticed unusual activity on your Google Account. To prevent account lockout, scan the QR code attached to this message within 30 minutes and sign in to confirm it's you.

[QR CODE IMAGE]

Google Account Recovery Team
